topic: Pre-trip checklist the night before you roll out

scenes.text: Night before: set surface, heat, wind and rain per segment
Then tick the *gear list* that fits those conditions
Set a one-tap *check-in* for peace of mind

content.caption:
Bikepacking planning tip: 180 km can mean 2.1 riding days. That's why the night-before check matters.

Pre-trip checklist, short version:
1. Re-check surface, heat, wind and rain for each segment.
2. Match your gear to those conditions.
3. Note where you can find water, food and bike repair.
4. Set a check-in so someone knows where you are.
5. Sleep. Seriously.

BikepackPilot does the planning part: it splits your route into 50 km segments and calculates realistic riding days, not just kilometres.

What's the one thing you always forget to pack?

Plan your next trip at bikepackpilot.com (link in bio).
